newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 9.98 bln lvs 6-mth, floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 9.98 bln lvs 6-mth, floater T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Monday sold 9.981 billion lev of six-month, floating interest T-bills yielding 41.02 percent until maturity under the current main interest rate, the central bank said.
Interest on the paper is due at maturity. It equals the central bank main interest rate, now set at 6.20 percent monthly, and is adjusted each time the rate changes.
Bids were received for 11.131 billion lev worth of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 9.981 billion levs of paper.
The issue was offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance.
